configDefinition.name: sync_group
configDefinition.description: Group identifier — screens sharing the same group take over together.

configDefinition.name: sync_server
configDefinition.description: URI of the synchronization server. Leave empty to use the signageOS default server.

configDefinition.name: sync_engine
configDefinition.description: Sync engine: "sync-server" (default) or "p2p-local" for LAN-only. All screens in a group must match.

configDefinition.name: interval_ms
configDefinition.description: How long the menuboard shows between takeovers, in milliseconds (default 30000).

configDefinition.name: takeover_ms
configDefinition.description: How long an image takeover shows, in milliseconds (default 10000). Video takeovers play to their end.

configDefinition.name: menuboard_items
configDefinition.description: JSON array of menuboard rows: [{name, price}]. Falls back to a demo menu when empty.

configDefinition.name: takeover_assets
configDefinition.description: JSON array of takeover content rotated each cycle: [{type:"video"|"image", uid, uri}]. Falls back to demo assets when empty.
